heroTitle: Building momentum toward a connected Pensacola
heroDescription: The Bluffline is moving from vision to reality. Track our progress from planning to construction.
grantBody: In January 2025, the Bluffline was awarded a $1.2 million Reconnecting Communities grant from the U.S. Department of Transportation to fund master planning, feasibility studies, and preliminary design for the Escambia Bay Waterfront Access Study. This work builds on decades of adopted plans that have consistently identified this corridor as a regional priority.
